name: Default
shortDescription: On-the-fly image resizing, cropping and compression server that serves AVIF, WebP, JPEG XL, MozJPEG or PNG from source URLs with a local cache.

alerts.message: By default Flyimg fetches and transforms images from any URL. Set restricted_domains and whitelist_domains, or security_key and security_iv for signed URLs, in the parameters.yml config file to prevent abuse.
